driver.label: DuckLake
driver.description: DuckLake via the DuckDB JDBC driver. Host/Port/Database/User/Password point at the Postgres CATALOG; S3 storage is configured in Driver properties.

property.label: Query guard
property.description: Before a read query runs, estimate how much it will read from object storage (EXPLAIN plus the catalog's file sizes) and ask above the threshold; afterwards, print what it actually read in the Output panel. Default on.

property.label: Warn above (MB)
property.description: Estimated read size above which the query guard asks before running a query. Default 100.

property.label: S3 endpoint (host:port)
property.description: S3 endpoint without scheme, e.g. localhost:9000 or s3.amazonaws.com. Leave blank for AWS default.

property.label: S3 access key
property.description: S3 access key id. Leave blank to use the AWS credential chain.

property.label: S3 region
property.description: e.g. us-east-1 (defaults to us-east-1 if blank)

property.label: S3 URL style
property.description: 'path' for MinIO/RustFS-style servers; blank = provider default (vhost)

property.label: S3 use SSL
property.description: On for https endpoints (AWS); off for local http

property.label: DuckLake DATA_PATH
property.description: Storage location, e.g. s3://bucket/prefix/ (trailing slash). Leave blank to browse existing catalogs. Setting it is what CREATES a catalog in the Metadata schema when that schema has none, and a value that does not match an existing catalog's own location is dropped with a warning.

property.label: Metadata schema (Postgres)
property.description: Postgres schema whose ducklake_* metadata tables should become the primary (active) catalog. Blank tries 'public' first, then the other readable catalogs. A schema the role cannot read, or that holds no catalog, is skipped with a warning; nothing is created there unless DATA_PATH is set.

property.label: Catalog alias
property.description: Name to attach the active catalog as, whichever one that turns out to be (defaults to its metadata schema, e.g. 'public'). Other catalogs are named after their schema, or <database>_<schema> when that name is taken.

property.label: Default schema (DuckLake)
property.description: Schema inside the active catalog that unqualified table names resolve to (each connection runs USE catalog.schema). Blank = main. A schema that does not exist only costs a warning.

property.label: Discover all catalogs
property.description: Attach every DuckLake catalog in the metadata database (one per Postgres schema). Default on. Off attaches only the Metadata schema one.

property.label: Discover other databases
property.description: Also probe every other database on the Postgres server you may connect to, and attach its DuckLake catalogs. Default on. A catalog whose schema name is already taken is named '<database>_<schema>'.

property.label: Stream result sets
property.description: Fetch large results in chunks instead of materializing them (DuckDB JDBC jdbc_stream_results). Default off: a streamed result set is invalidated as soon as another statement runs on the same connection, and DBeaver runs metadata queries while a slow result is still being read, which fails with 'Invalid Input Error: Invalid result set'. Turn it on only for huge exports.
